Bill.BriefDescription: Criminalizing the failure to report the death or disappearance of a child within a specified time by certain persons responsible for the care of the child.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to criminalizing the failure to report the death ordisappearance of a child within a specified time by certain personsresponsible for the care of the child; adding a new chapter to Title 9ARCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any parent, legal guardian, or caregiver whoknowingly fails to notify law enforcement within forty-eight hours oflearning that a child, in his or her care and less than thirteen yearsof age, is missing is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.
Any parent, legal guardian, or caregiver whoknowingly fails to notify law enforcement within six hours of learningof the death of a minor child in his or her care is guilty of a classC felony.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 9A RCW.
